name: av_stock_intraday
description:
Intraday OHLCV bars for one stock from Alpha Vantage (TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY), latest 100 bars.
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Time Series (<interval>)"} keyed by timestamp (US/Eastern), each with "1. open" to "5. volume".
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min; default 5min).
Daily and longer history: av_stock_daily, av_stock_weekly. Intraday VWAP: av_vwap.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "15min"}
